title: Attention: rows meet columns
summary: One head of attention, the heart of a transformer, with no loop over words: every query against every key in one matrix product, a softmax by row, and each word's output a weighted mix of the words it looks at. Ends on the live page.

scenes.heading: Attention, as arrays
scenes.narration: This is attention, the heart of a transformer. Every word looks at every other word, with no loop.
lines: the animal did not cross the street because it was tired
A row a word: how much it looks at each word.

scenes.heading: 1. Queries and keys
scenes.narration: Each word gets a query, what it looks for, and a key, what it offers. Each is one matrix product. Here, it and tired look for something alive.
lines: A row a word, a column a feature: alive, a place.
it and tired ask for alive. The animal offers it.

scenes.heading: 2. Rows meet columns
scenes.narration: Now rows meet columns. Every query times every key, in one product with a transpose. That is the whole table of scores.

lines.xtl: u:s_cores := { X -> ((X '+ '* i_nner Wq) '+ '* i_nner o_\ X '+ '* i_nner Wk) / 2.0 ^ 0.5 }

lines: Queries times keys transposed: every pair at once.
Rows 9 and 11, it and tired, meet column 2, animal.

scenes.heading: 3. Softmax, by row
scenes.narration: A softmax turns each row into weights that add up to one. Tired puts almost all of its weight on the animal.

lines.xtl: u:a_ttend := { X M -> M at:w_eights u:s_cores X }
l:w_eights := { M S -> nn:s_oftmax S - 1e9 * 1.0 - M }

lines: Each row adds up to 1. A mask M can hide words.

scenes.heading: 4. The weighted mix
scenes.narration: Then the values are mixed by those weights. So tired, and it, now carry the animal's meaning.
lines: Each word's output: the weighted mix of its values.
it and tired now carry the first feature: alive.
